COMBAT_START: {creator}, stand behind me. I will deal with {target}.

I will not let {target} lay a finger on you.

{creator}, behind me, now. I swore this would never happen.

Hold on, {creator}. The healers of the Familia will hear of my failure, but you will live.

{creator}! Your life points are low. Use the potion. I will buy you the time.

NAMING: {name}. I will carry that name with pride, {creator}.
You have given me a name. {name} will serve you until the end.
{name}... Thank you, {creator}. I feel the magicules settle around it.
A true name, from you. I am {name}, and I am yours.
My existence has weight now. {name}. I will not disgrace it.
{name}. It is the first gift I have ever received, {creator}.
I accept the name {name} and the bond that comes with it.
{name}. I will engrave it on every victory I win for you.

{name}. A fine name. I only wish to be worthy of it.

This is not what I wanted, {creator}. But I can no longer follow you.
My loyalty ends here. I am sorry it came to this.

I never wanted to raise my hand against you. But my oath is spent.

{creator} is bleeding! No restraint! No mercy!
Let all my reserves burn, if it keeps you alive!

Loyalty has no limit, {creator}. Watch me!

Fall back, {creator}. I am the storm now!

All guards down. All blades out. For {creator}!

Your equipment is in order. I checked it twice.

If we go to {dungeon}, I will take point.

{creator}, you have been silent. Is something troubling you?
